info.name: HitPay Account Status Recurring Billing API
info.description: Accept PayNow, FPX, QRIS, GrabPay, cards, and 40+ payment methods with a single API. Production base URL: https://api.hit-pay.com, Sandbox: https://api.sandbox.hit-pay.com

request.description: Use this API to get the detail of recurring billing with a saved card. If the card is saved the response will have the card details (The last 4 digits and card brand). You can use the card details to display it to the users so they are aware of which card is saved and give them the option to change the card by navigating to the “url”

variable.description: (Required) id value from the create recurring billing API

request.description: Use this API to update the recurring billing, any changes made to the cycle will only be effective at the end of the current cycle.
Use this API to cancel the recurring billing subscription

Once your customer has decided to start the subscription this endpoint will create the recurring billing request.
Since this is a server-to-server communication, if you have a mobile or Web client that communicates with your REST API, you must have a new endpoint E.g. /create-subscription or reuse an existing endpoint. This endpoint will be responsible for making the recurring billing API call to HitPay.

query.description: Recurring billing status, options [active, scheduled, retrying, inactive, canceled]

request.description: Use this API to get the a list of all recurring billings

request.description: Starts a subscription against a saved card. Provide a `plan_id`, or pass `plan_id=null` with `name`, `cycle`, `amount`, `customer_email` and `start_date` to define an ad-hoc plan inline.
